messages:
Maya (Sales): Quick sync 02: CuroMed wants to move from POC to pilot. Procurement sent an order form but their legal team returned an MSA with several DPA/SLA redlines. They also insist on net60 and want the invoice to include a PO number on the first page. Can legal+finance advise next steps?
Noah (Legal): Please attach the MSA redline. My initial red flags: data residency clause, subprocessor notification window, encryption key responsibilities.
Maya (Sales): Uploaded: https://redwood.app/drive/CURO-MSA-redline.pdf. Theyre asking for vendor-managed keys for hosted deployments and a 7-day notice for subprocessor changes. Procurement is asking for net60 from activation.
Priya (Finance): Net60 from activation is risky. We typically agree net30 or net45 for new customers unless underwriting approves net60 and the first invoice isn't > $75k. If they need net60, we need CFO sign-off and possibly payment milestones. Also want PO before activation if possible.
Liam (Eng): For the POC we can host in eu-central-1. If they require vendor-managed keys, that impacts our operational model; we need to confirm isolation requirements (dedicated tenancy) and whether they expect HSM-level KMS. That will likely push to a Dedicated offer.
Noah (Legal): My plan: (1) reject vendor-managed KMS for hosted plans; offer documented controls for Redwood-managed keys and an opt-in CMK (customer-managed keys) clause tied to Dedicated/Private deployments, (2) change subprocessor notice to 30 days with emergency 72-hour disclosure for high-risk subprocessors, (3) narrow indemnity scope and add standard SOC2/pen-test attestation delivery timeline.
Maya (Sales): DocuSign routing: procurement -> legal review -> billing -> exec. They asked for a checkbox to confirm PO attached before final signature. Can DocuBot add that?
DocuBot: Envelope draft `CURO-OF-2163456789` created in sandbox. Signers ordered as requested. Inserted custom checkbox: "PO attached" required before final sign.
Priya (Finance): If PO not received within 5 business days after signing we hold shipment/activation. Also if net60 requested, add a payment milestone: 50% on signing, remainder net60. This is preferable to unpaid exposure.
Liam (Eng): I'll draft a 1-page appendix that clarifies logs retained, PII handling, and that eu-central-1 will be the processing region. Also will specify that for hosted with Redwood-managed keys, we provide audit logs and key access proofs.
Noah (Legal): Uploaded redline back: https://redwood.app/drive/CURO-MSA-our-redline.pdf. Key change text: "Customer may request CMK for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted plans Redwood uses Redwood-managed KMS with SOC2 controls; vendor-managed keys for hosted plans are not permitted. Subprocessor notice: 30 days; emergency disclosures within 72 hours." I left comments to help sales with negotiation language.
Maya (Sales): Thanks Noah. I will send the redline + envelope link to the buyer. Quick question: can we print PO number on the DocuSign first page header? That was a specific request.
DocuBot: DocuSign template supports custom fields. Will populate PO field on page 1 if provided prior to envelope send. If checkbox "PO attached" is checked at signature time, value will be included in header.
Priya (Finance): Confirm whether net60 is from signed date or activation. We prefer signed date. If customer insists activation, require prepay or bank guarantee for the first invoice.
Maya (Sales): I'll ask them to confirm net60 from signed date. Also ask for PO contact and expected PO ETA.
Liam (Eng): Uploaded draft appendix: https://redwood.app/drive/CURO-eu-appendix-draft.pdf. It outlines retention windows and log categories.
Noah (Legal): Extra note: if they persist on vendor-managed keys for hosted, propose compensating controls: dedicated tenancy, read-only audit escrow, and quarterly attestation. That might be acceptable for larger accounts but should be scoped into pricing.
Maya (Sales): Pricing note 06: CuroMed expects pilot discount and wants pricing locked for 9 months. Can we do a pilot discount tied to usage caps? Priya?
Priya (Finance): We can offer a pilot discount but prefer it time-limited (e.g., 90 days) or usage-capped. Locking pricing for 9 months is OK if they commit to a minimum spend threshold. We should capture that on the order form and in the SOW.
Maya (Sales): Action items: Noah finalize redline (EOD), DocuBot prepare envelope with PO checkbox, Priya to confirm CFO threshold for net60, Liam attach appendix to order form, I will request PO contact and confirm net60 baseline.
DocuBot: Envelope `CURO-OF-2163456789` status: draft -> for signature after legal applies final redline. Sandbox envelope URL: https://docusign.redwood/ENVELOPE/2163456789.
Maya (Sales): Sending to buyer now. Will update this thread when they return PO/confirm net60. :pray: 
Priya (Finance): If PO delayed >7 business days escalate to me for decision on prepay.
Noah (Legal): Added comments in redline with fallback language for keys and a recommended SLA uptime target.
Maya (Sales): Thanks team.
